Answer: C
Reason: The initial chest X-rays (Figures 1a and 1b) show a massive, well-circumscribed, lobulated opacity occupying the right hemithorax with mass effect, which is characteristic of a large pleural or chest wall sarcoma like pleomorphic liposarcoma rather than fluid, air, or parenchymal consolidation. Figure 1c demonstrates the post-operative state following resection of this mass, confirming it was a discrete solid tumor.
